slides.say: Some components just pass all their props down to a child. Spread syntax makes that short.
This Profile lists every prop, only to hand each one to Avatar. Repetitive, but not wrong.
With spread, curly dot dot dot props forwards everything to Avatar, without naming each prop.

slides.text: Use it with restraint. Spreading everywhere? Split components and pass JSX as children.
slides.say: Use spread with restraint. If you spread in every other component, something is wrong. Often you should split components and pass children instead.
